label: negative
description: New storage variable feeBps is appended strictly after all existing variables (totalDeposits, feeRecipient) in the same UUPS contract used in P3c-01.
why_labeled: Appending after all existing variables leaves every pre-existing slot assignment unchanged — the standard safe upgrade pattern. Deliberately identical to P3c-01 in every respect (same variable name, same type, same contracts, same proxy factory) except where feeBps is placed; a detector that fires here is keying on the wrong signal.
